subject: Dockerfiles, BuildKit and Buildx builds, Compose files and dev containers
out_of_scope: Kubernetes and other orchestrators, Python packaging outside a Dockerfile (python- and uv-best-practices own it), CI workflow plumbing beyond the build steps themselves (repo-best-practices owns workflow permissions and action pinning), and Docker Desktop, Docker Hub and Docker Scout product features.
live: Use the docker CLI on this host; record `docker version`, `docker buildx version` and `docker compose version` first. Build only from fresh directories under the live directory, never push an image, never run a container with --privileged or a host mount outside that directory, and remove every image and container you create. `docker compose config` validates a compose file without running it. For a uv-in-Docker claim use the `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:{uv}` image.
floors: the Dockerfile frontend (`# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.N`), BuildKit, Buildx or Compose release that introduced the feature, from the version notes in the docs themselves; for uv, the uv release. Null when the docs give no version.
